attacks.name: Webline Kick
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: If the target character is Size 3 or less, before damage is dealt, you may Throw the target character away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Venom Blast
steps: After the attack is resolved, the target character drops all objective tokens they are holding.

superPowers.name: Great Responsibility (Affiliation: Web Warriors)
superPowers.body: Allied characters may re-roll one defense die. Additionally, they may modify and reroll |!failure| results while they are holding or contesting an objective token.

superPowers.name: Web Swing
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. The next time it makes a Webline Kick attack this turn, add two dice to that attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.
